correctness.rationale: An EF two-round game examines atomic multiplication among e,x,y; the possible y collisions with e,x,x^-1,x^2 and square root give nine pointed categories E,I±,T±,F±,X±. Existence of each category is rank<=2 definable and matching types gives a Duplicator reply for every Spoiler first move. Even square roots of permutations require even counts of even cycles, with parity controlled by half-count and pairable equal odd cycles (including fixed points). The centralizer involution criterion yields T- at 5,6,7,9,10; I- exactly when degree ≡4 or5 mod8. Remaining thresholds give the seven classes, proven by symbolic cycle constructions for all n. Independent cycle-partition census n=5..32 and exact small alternating-permutation multiplication/square checks n<=8 are corroboration, not extrapolated proofs.
